# Taggd

> > India's first AI-powered talent fulfilment platform transforming recruitment through GenAI-driven RPO, executive search, and talent acquisition consulting.

Taggd is an enterprise talent acquisition and recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) provider leveraging artificial intelligence and human expertise to deliver scalable hiring solutions. The platform serves multiple industries across India with specialized offerings in RPO, executive search, and talent strategy consulting.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered recruitment
- Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)
- GenAI talent fulfilment
- Enterprise RPO
- Executive search & CXO hiring
- Talent acquisition strategy
- Employer branding
- DEI & inclusive hiring
- Leadership pipeline mapping
- Project RPO
- Workforce consulting
- India recruitment market
- Industry-specific hiring
- Talent transformation
- Global Capability Centers (GCC)

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [India's first AI-powered talent fulfilment solution | Taggd](https://taggd.in): Taggd's AI-powered talent fulfilment platform combining machine and human capabilities for recruitment transformation.
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) Solutions | Taggd](https://taggd.in/solutions/recruitment-process-outsourcing): Taggd's RPO solutions for enterprise hiring, including Enterprise RPO and Project RPO offerings.
- [Enterprise RPO Solutions for Scalable Hiring | Taggd](https://taggd.in/solutions/recruitment-process-outsourcing/enterprise-rpo): Enterprise RPO solution for high-volume, scalable hiring with GenAI-powered recruitment.
- [Agile Project RPO Solutions for On-Demand Hiring | Taggd](https://taggd.in/solutions/recruitment-process-outsourcing/project-rpo): Project RPO for agile, on-demand recruitment support with quick quality hires.
